segments.prompt:
9:16 vertical, 4 seconds, studio lookbook video for a quiet luxury handbag brand, locked off camera on a tripod, no camera movement, bright soft even studio light with a gentle warm cast, subtle photo grain like a fashion editorial filmed on a phone.

@Image1 is the model and stays the same person across the whole ad. @Image2 is the Velantra Bow Tote and the bag in frame matches it exactly: a small ivory cotton canvas tote with a boat shaped silhouette, two ivory canvas top handles, a denim blue canvas ribbon with white contrast stitching threaded through gold oval grommets and tied in a neat bow at the front center, tiny gold feet on the base. No logos on the bag.

Model: the woman from @Image1, 38 years old, long dark brunette hair falling past her shoulders, sun tanned skin, warm brown eyes, soft natural makeup. Wardrobe for this shot: an oversized black crewneck knit sweater with relaxed sleeves and a glossy chocolate brown leather look midi skirt, simple black shoes.

[0:00 to 0:04] Camera: static full body framing, she stands centered against a seamless warm white studio wall with a soft floor shadow, body angled slightly to the right. She carries the ivory bow tote in her left hand by both handles at her side, the denim bow facing the camera, while her right hand sweeps her hair back from her face in one slow relaxed motion, then she settles her gaze just past the camera with a calm confident expression, small natural weight shift, nothing else moves. In frame: only the model, the bag and the bare studio wall. Not in frame: no props, no furniture, no other people.

On screen text: a persistent line of small clean white sans serif text sits at the center of the frame across her midline for the entire 4 seconds and reads exactly: 1 bag 3 looks. A second persistent wordmark in thin white letterspaced serif capitals sits at the lower center of the frame and reads exactly: VELANTRA. Both stay perfectly still the whole time. No other text anywhere in the frame.

Audio: quiet studio room tone only, soft cloth rustle, no voice, no music.
